reason: I already have a bottle I like, and my office and home tap water are fine. The only way to get the decent bottle price is to sign up for another filter subscription, and I've been burned by those before.
objection: Paying $63 for a bottle alone when I don't buy the plan, or getting locked into recurring filter charges I'll forget to cancel. 'Cancel any time' is what every subscription says.
would_change_my_mind: A fair one-off price for the bottle with no plan (around $35 shipped) and filters I can buy one at a time without a subscription.
